title: DemoCreate: Declarative Audio-Visual Demo Generation for Software
description: DemoCreate generates inspectable artifacts from declarative scenes, narration and actions: silent WAVs, synthetic frames, captions, transcripts and a timed HTML image preview without audio playback. Fixed inputs, assets, configuration and environment are required for core byte reproducibility. Kokoro and system TTS are implemented optional voices; ffmpeg is required for MP4. Default synchronization interpolates known text over measured clip durations, not acoustic word onsets. Supplied onset annotations can be scored with explicit missing-data accounting, without verifying independence or replacing the missing study. Whisper, Chatterbox and Manim remain unwired. Version 0.8.0 is an unpublished candidate; no final archive DOI or release date is asserted.
